create_llava_onevision_model: create a LLaVA-Onevision model for conditional generation with multimodal image and video inputs
build_multimodal_projector: build a multimodal projector that maps vision features to language model hidden space using two linear layers
process_image_pixels: process image pixel tensors through the vision tower and projector to produce merged patch embeddings
process_video_pixels: process video frame tensors through the vision tower, projector, and pooling to produce video embeddings
run_multimodal_forward_pass: run the forward pass of LLaVA-Onevision with input IDs, positions, and multimodal embeddings
